title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Psalms 23: Yahweh as shepherd, green pastures and still waters, the valley of the shadow of death and dwelling in Yahweh's house.

questions.text: What does the psalmist call Yahweh in the first verse?
questions.explanation: Psalms 23:1 says, 'Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.'

questions.text: Because Yahweh is his shepherd, what does the psalmist say about himself?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, 'Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.'

questions.text: Where does he make the psalmist lie down?
questions.explanation: Psalms 23:2 says, 'He makes me lie down in green pastures.'

answers.text: In the shade of a tree

questions.text: Beside what does he lead the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says, 'He leads me beside still waters.'

questions.text: For whose sake does he guide the psalmist in the paths of righteousness?
questions.explanation: Psalms 23:3 says, 'He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.'

answers.text: For the sake of the psalmist's father
For the sake of the land

questions.text: Through which valley does the psalmist say he may walk?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, 'Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil.'

answers.text: The valley of the shadow of death

questions.text: What two things comfort the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Psalms 23:4 says, 'Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.'

questions.text: In whose presence is a table prepared before the psalmist?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says, 'You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies.'

questions.text: With what is the psalmist's head anointed?
questions.explanation: Psalms 23:5 says, 'You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.'

questions.text: How long will the psalmist dwell in Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, 'I will dwell in Yahweh's house forever.'
